description: Mono recording: speakers cannot be told apart, so owners must not be asserted wrongly.

segments.text: Good morning, I'm calling about the TA6 property information form. We haven't received the completed copy yet.
Sorry, I've been away. I'll fill it in tonight and send it back by Friday.
That's great. And the fittings and contents form, the TA10, is also outstanding.
Oh, I didn't realise. I'll do both together.
Once we have both we can send the contract pack to the other side.
